patthana23.33:1.1: Namicchattaniyataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sammattaniyato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana23.33:2.1: Namicchattaniyataṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā micchattaniyato akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana23.33:3.1: Namicchattaniyataṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
